note: Glosses are editorial (English authoritative, 中文 careful); manuscript & listing counts are read from the catalogue.

entries.term: พระเครื่อง

glosses.en: A Buddhist amulet, usually a small moulded image of a Buddha or revered monk.
glosses.zh: 佛牌 — 多為佛陀或高僧的小型模製聖像護符。

glosses.en: The Somdej amulet — among the most revered Thai amulet types, the 'king of amulets.'
glosses.zh: 崇迪佛牌 — 最受尊崇的泰國佛牌之一，有『佛牌之王』之稱。

glosses.en: Jatukham Ramathep — a guardian-deity amulet cult that swept Thailand in the 2000s.
glosses.zh: 加都堪拉瑪贴 — 二〇〇〇年代風靡泰國的護法神護符。

glosses.en: A spell inscribed on a thin metal scroll, rolled tight and empowered — worn for protection, invulnerability, or love.
glosses.zh: 符管 — 刻於薄金屬並捲緊加持的經文護符，用於護身、刀槍不入或招情。

entries.term: เครื่องราง

glosses.en: Talisman or charm, in the broad sense — any empowered object worn or carried for its power.
glosses.zh: 護身符（廣義）— 一切經加持、隨身佩帶以求靈力的物件。

glosses.en: Auspicious sacred objects — the umbrella category for amulets, charms and consecrated items.
glosses.zh: 聖物 · 吉祥物 — 佛牌、護符與開光物件的總稱。

glosses.en: The eclipse-deity — the shadow-planet that swallows sun and moon; propitiated to turn misfortune to fortune.
glosses.zh: 羅睺 — 食日月的影曜之神，供奉以轉厄為福。

entries.term: โหราศาสตร์

glosses.en: Astrology — the reckoning of time, star and fate; the diviner's science of auspicious days and birth-charts.
glosses.zh: 占星術 — 推算時辰、星曜與命運，擇吉日、排命盤之學。

entries.term: เมตตามหานิยม

glosses.en: Loving-kindness + 'great popularity' — charm that makes one widely liked and favoured.
glosses.zh: 慈心廣受愛戴 — 使人緣廣結、備受喜愛的法門。

glosses.en: Loving-kindness — as a magical quality, the power to draw goodwill and warmth from all who meet you.
glosses.zh: 慈心 — 作為法門的特質，能招來眾人的善意與愛戴。

entries.term: สีผึ้งเสน่ห์

glosses.en: Enchanted lip-wax — a balm consecrated to lend the wearer allure.
glosses.zh: 招情蜂蠟 — 開光的唇蠟，增添佩者魅力。

glosses.en: Love-drawing allure — charms and rites to kindle desire and attraction.
glosses.zh: 魅惑 · 招情 — 引動愛慕與情緣的法術。

entries.term: ท้าวเวสสุวรรณ

glosses.en: Vaishravana — guardian king of the north, giant lord of yakṣas, who wards off ghosts and evil.
glosses.zh: 多聞天王（毗沙門）— 北方護法天王，夜叉之主，驅鬼辟邪。

glosses.en: Buddho, 'the Awakened One' — the commonest meditation word of the Thai forest tradition (bud- on the in-breath, -dho on the out-breath) and a seed-word in katha; with dhammo and saṅgho it makes the Triple-Gem triad.
glosses.zh: 佛陀（覺者）— 泰國森林傳統最常用的禪修念誦詞（入息 bud-、出息 -dho），亦為咒語種子；與 dhammo、saṅgho 合為三寶三聯。

glosses.en: A Pali incantation — verses of power, recited to activate a charm, ward danger, or draw fortune.
glosses.zh: 咒語 — 巴利語的靈驗偈頌，誦唸以啟動法物、驅邪或招福。

glosses.en: Buddhaṃ — 'the Buddha' as the object of the refuge formula: buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi, 'I go to the Buddha for refuge'. The three refuge lines open almost every rite in the corpus.
glosses.zh: 佛陀（受格）— 皈依文之對象：buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi「我皈依佛」。三皈依幾乎開啟藏書中每一場法事。

glosses.en: Dhammaṃ — 'the Dhamma' in the second refuge line: dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi.
glosses.zh: 法（受格）— 第二句皈依文：dhammaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi。

glosses.en: Saṅghaṃ — 'the Sangha' in the third refuge line: saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi.
glosses.zh: 僧（受格）— 第三句皈依文：saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi。

glosses.en: 'Homage' — the first word of the salutation (namo tassa bhagavato…), and the word with which a katha, a recipe, or a rite begins.
glosses.zh: 南無 · 禮敬 — 禮敬文（namo tassa bhagavato…）的首字；咒語、藥方與法事皆以此開頭。

entries.term: นะโมพุทธายะ

glosses.en: 'Homage to the Buddha' — the five-syllable formula na-mo-phut-tha-ya, the commonest katha in the corpus. Tradition holds each syllable stands for one of the five Buddhas of this aeon (พระเจ้าห้าพระองค์); inscribed in yantra as a 5-cell row, rotated and reversed in consecration.
glosses.zh: 南無佛陀耶 — 五音節咒 na-mo-phut-tha-ya，全藏書中最常見的咒語。傳統以每一音對應本劫五佛（พระเจ้าห้าพระองค์）；常以五格書入符陣，順逆輪轉以加持。

glosses.en: Dhammo, 'the Teaching' — recited as the second of the Triple-Gem triad (buddho dhammo saṅgho).
glosses.zh: 達摩（法）— 三寶三聯之第二（buddho dhammo saṅgho）。

glosses.en: Itipiso — the opening of the recollection of the Buddha's qualities (itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ sammāsambuddho…). The katha tradition recites it, reverses it, counts it (Itipiso 108) and lays its syllables out as yantra.
glosses.zh: 伊諦比索 — 佛德憶念文（itipi so bhagavā arahaṃ…）的起句。咒法傳統誦之、倒讀之、計數之（伊諦比索一〇八），並將其音節排為符陣。

glosses.en: Arahaṃ, 'the Worthy One' — first of the nine qualities of the Buddha; also breathed as a two-beat meditation word (a-ra-haṃ) and used as a seed in protective katha.
glosses.zh: 阿羅漢（應供）— 佛九德之首；亦作兩拍呼吸禪修詞（a-ra-haṃ），並為護身咒的種子音。

glosses.en: Saraṇaṃ, 'refuge' — the word at the centre of each refuge line.
glosses.zh: 皈依（saraṇaṃ）— 每句皈依文的中心詞。

glosses.en: Upekkhā, 'equanimity' — fourth of the four brahmavihāra.
glosses.zh: 捨（upekkhā）— 四梵住之第四。

glosses.en: The four-syllable 'heart of the elements' — na, ma, pha, tha, one for each of earth, water, fire and wind. Written into 4×4 yantra squares and read forward and backward (anuloma / patiloma) while a charm is empowered.
glosses.zh: 四大心咒 — na·ma·pha·tha 四音，對應地、水、火、風四大。書於四乘四符陣，加持時順讀、逆讀。

glosses.en: The three syllables ma-a-u — the 'heart of the Triple Gem' (Buddha, Dhamma, Sangha) in Thai esoteric use; the same three sounds as Om (a-u-ma), reordered.
glosses.zh: 三音「麻·阿·烏」— 泰國密法中的三寶心咒（佛·法·僧）；與「唵」（a-u-ma）同音而異序。

glosses.en: Bhagavā, 'the Blessed One' — the Buddha's epithet and the second word of the Itipiso; often stands alone in a yantra cell as a seed-word.
glosses.zh: 薄伽梵（世尊）— 佛之尊號，Itipiso 的第二字；常單獨置於符格作種子字。

glosses.en: Sabbe, 'all' — opens the loving-kindness and protective formulae (sabbe sattā… 'may all beings…'), which the manuscripts recite over water, oil and the body.
glosses.zh: 一切（sabbe）— 慈心與護身文之首字（sabbe sattā…「願一切眾生…」），藏書中常對水、油與身體誦之。

glosses.en: Ehi, 'come!' — the summoning imperative that opens katha of calling: customers, lovers, spirits, fortune (ehi… piyaṃ mama).
glosses.zh: 來（ehi）— 召喚式命令語，開啟招客、招情、召靈、招財之咒（ehi… piyaṃ mama）。

entries.term: สิทธิการิยะ

glosses.en: 'May it be accomplished' — the auspicious word with which a Thai manuscript, recipe or formula opens; the scribe's invocation, and the marker that a new text is beginning.
glosses.zh: 悉地迦利耶（願得成就）— 泰文古籍、藥方或咒法起首的吉祥語；書者之祈請，亦是新篇開始的標記。

glosses.en: Karuṇā, 'compassion' — second of the four brahmavihāra (mettā karuṇā muditā upekkhā), recited in sequence as a blessing and named among the qualities a charm bestows.
glosses.zh: 悲（karuṇā）— 四梵住之第二（慈悲喜捨），依序誦為祝福，亦列於法物所賜之德。

glosses.en: 'Of the Blessed One' — the form heard in the salutation namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa.
glosses.zh: 世尊（屬格）— 見於禮敬文 namo tassa bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa。

glosses.en: Saṅgho, 'the Community' — third of the Triple-Gem triad.
glosses.zh: 僧伽（僧）— 三寶三聯之第三。

glosses.en: Gacchāmi, 'I go' — the verb that closes each refuge line.
glosses.zh: 我去 · 我往（gacchāmi）— 結束每句皈依文的動詞。

entries.term: สิทธิกิจจัง

glosses.en: 'May the task succeed' — from the success-blessing siddhikiccaṃ siddhikammaṃ siddhikāriya tathāgato, recited to seal a rite or a making.
glosses.zh: 願事成就（siddhikiccaṃ）— 出自成就祝文 siddhikiccaṃ siddhikammaṃ siddhikāriya tathāgato，誦以封印法事或製作。

glosses.en: Dukkhaṃ, 'suffering' — with aniccaṃ (impermanence) and anattā (not-self) one of the three marks; recited as a contemplation formula and used as a seed in katha.
glosses.zh: 苦（dukkhaṃ）— 與無常、無我合為三法印；作觀修文誦之，亦為咒語種子。

glosses.en: Muditā, 'sympathetic joy' — third of the four brahmavihāra.
glosses.zh: 喜（muditā）— 四梵住之第三。

glosses.en: Namāmihaṃ, 'I pay homage' — the closing word of many salutation-katha (… namāmihaṃ).
glosses.zh: 我禮敬（namāmihaṃ）— 眾多禮敬咒的結尾詞。

glosses.en: Anattā, 'not-self' — third of the three marks (aniccaṃ dukkhaṃ anattā).
glosses.zh: 無我（anattā）— 三法印之第三。

glosses.en: The sacred syllable นะ — a seed-letter at the heart of countless katha and yantra; the tradition counts 108 of its forms.
glosses.zh: 「那」聖音字 — 眾多咒與符的種子字，傳有一百零八變化。

glosses.en: A phallic amulet — carved for protection, virility and warding of harm.
glosses.zh: 陽形護符 — 雕製以護身、旺陽、避害。

entries.term: พญาเต่าเรือน

glosses.en: The turtle amulet — for longevity and steady, sheltering wealth.
glosses.zh: 龜將軍 — 象徵長壽與穩固招財。

glosses.en: A cowrie-shell remedy charm — the classic guard against black magic and curse.
glosses.zh: 解厄寶螺 — 對治邪術與詛咒的傳統寶貝護符。

entries.term: กะลาตาเดียว

glosses.en: A rare one-eyed coconut shell — a single natural sprout-hole makes it a powerful protective charm.
glosses.zh: 獨眼椰殼 — 天然僅一芽孔的稀有椰殼，為強力護符。

entries.term: เขี้ยวเสือ

glosses.en: Tiger fang — worn for authority, command over others and protection.
glosses.zh: 虎牙 — 佩以增威權、懾眾、護身。

glosses.en: Medicine — herbal remedy and the medical manuals; healing sits inside wichaa, not apart from it.
glosses.zh: 藥 · 草藥 — 醫方與醫書；療癒本屬 wichaa 之內，不與其分。

glosses.en: Invulnerability — the classic martial protection, skin that blades cannot cut.
glosses.zh: 刀槍不入 — 經典的護體法門，刀刃不能傷。

glosses.en: Sacred powder of Buddha-virtue — ground from consecrated materials and pressed into amulets.
glosses.zh: 佛粉（聖粉）— 由開光材料研磨，壓入佛牌之中。

glosses.en: Chewed betel-quid — spat and worked into folk blessing, healing and love magic.
glosses.zh: 檳榔渣 — 用於民間祝福、療癒與情術。

entries.term: น้ำมันมนต์

glosses.en: Enchanted oil — consecrated for love, luck or persuasion, anointed on skin or object.
glosses.zh: 法油 · 咒油 — 為招情、招運或說服而開光，塗於身或物。

glosses.en: The ritual master's knife — for exorcism, cutting malign influence, and consecrating charms.
glosses.zh: 法師刀 — 用於驅邪、斬煞與開光法物。

glosses.en: To cultivate by recitation — repeating a katha, in the mind or aloud, a set number of times to charge a charm or oneself; the manuscripts' verb for 'recite / meditate on'.
glosses.zh: 修念 · 持誦（bhāvanā）— 以心或口反覆誦咒若干遍，以加持法物或自身；藏書中「誦／觀修」之動詞。

glosses.en: Candle — offering and instrument both: candles of set weight and number open the rite, and their flame or dripping wax carries the consecration.
glosses.zh: 蠟燭 — 既是供品也是法器：定重定數之燭開啟法事，其火與蠟滴承載加持。

glosses.en: The precepts (sīla — five or eight) — the moral discipline the manuscripts set alongside recitation as its condition.
glosses.zh: 戒（sīla，五戒或八戒）— 藏書與持誦並列、作為其條件的道德律儀。

glosses.en: To consecrate by spell — breathe a katha over water, oil, wax, powder or an amulet to empower it. The central verb of the craft.
glosses.zh: 咒加持 — 對水、油、蠟、粉或護符誦咒吹氣以賦靈；法門的核心動詞。

glosses.en: A count of recitations — 'recite 3 คาบ, 7 คาบ, 108 คาบ'; the unit in which the manuscripts measure a katha's work.
glosses.zh: 遍（誦咒計數單位）—「誦三遍、七遍、一〇八遍」；藏書衡量咒功之單位。

glosses.en: Incense stick — counted out in set numbers (3, 5, 9, 16…) as the offering that opens a rite and honours the teacher-line.
glosses.zh: 香 — 以定數（三、五、九、十六…）供奉，開啟法事並敬師承。

glosses.en: The 'golden boy' — a child-spirit effigy kept and fed for luck, wealth and protection.
glosses.zh: 金童 — 供養以求財、護佑的靈童造像。

glosses.en: The beckoning lady — her raised hand calls in customers and wealth; the merchant's charm.
glosses.zh: 招財女神 — 舉手招客招財，商家的守護。

glosses.en: Ai Khai — the boy-spirit of Wat Chedi, famed for granting luck and answered wishes.
glosses.zh: 艾蓋童子 — 柴迪寺的靈童，以賜運、有求必應聞名。

entries.term: หลวงปู่ทวด

glosses.en: A revered southern monk (16th–17th c.), whose amulets are believed to protect from harm and misfortune.
glosses.zh: 龍菩托祖師 — 受尊崇的南方高僧，其佛牌被信能護身避險。

glosses.en: The ascetic hermit-seers — the teacher-figures at the root of the tradition, patrons of yantra, katha and healing.
glosses.zh: 修行隱士 · 仙人 — 傳統根源的祖師，符、咒與醫術的守護者。

glosses.en: A yantra inked onto cloth — a protective banner or wearing-cloth carrying the diagram.
glosses.zh: 符布 — 繪有法陣的護身布或旗。

glosses.en: A sacred diagram of letters, syllables and lines — drawn, inscribed or tattooed to protect, empower, or attract. The north's core visual magic.
glosses.zh: 符 · 護身法陣 — 由聖字、音節與線條構成的幾何圖，用以護身、加持或招引。
